task.description: Validate the ISS-502 test artefacts before routing to TEST-RUNNER. tests/integration/iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig was written by TEST-DESIGNER (step 03) and then patched twice by BACKEND-DEV rework (step 00b) to fix an unrelated fresh-DB-bootstrap blocker and to remove a webhook_deliveries table-list mismatch. Confirm the test file still meets all TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR gate criteria per CLAUDE.md's TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR section: (1) all 4 documented MUST test cases (TC-ISS502-01..04) have a runnable integration test, (2) no error.SkipZigTest anywhere in the file, (3) fixtures use per-test UUIDs, (4) tests clean up after themselves (including on failure paths — check defer usage), (5) tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent. ISS-502 is not a sequential-UI-journey requirement (it's a backend admin/data-migration operation), so the pipeline-test checks (6)-(10) in your instructions do not apply — note them as N/A rather than MAJOR issues.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 MUST test cases have runnable integration tests
No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST test
Tests clean up after themselves on all paths

result.summary: tests/integration/iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig validated against tests/specs/ISS-502.md. All 4 MUST test cases (TC-ISS502-01..04) present as runnable, non-stubbed Zig test blocks matching their documented steps/expectations. Zero error.SkipZigTest occurrences. Fixtures use per-test randomUuidStr() v4 UUIDs (tenant_id + derived schema name), not shared constants. Every test registers `defer cleanupTenant(...)` immediately after fixture-ID generation, before setupFixture() runs, so cleanup fires on all exit paths including the assertion-failure paths in TC-03/TC-04. testDbUrl()/helpers.TestHarness.init() both explicitly check EnvironmentVariableMissing and return a clear MissingTestDatabaseUrl error (not a skip) if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent. SPT_BUSINESS_TABLES in the test file is byte-for-byte identical (21 tables, same order) to src/admin/tenant_migration.zig's list, and the webhook_deliveries exclusion is correctly documented against the TNT-01 21-table design. Pipeline-test checks (6)-(10) are N/A: ISS-502 is a backend data-migration transaction, no web/tests/e2e/pipelines/ involvement. Corroborating live run: discovered BPM_TEST_DB_URL (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test) pointed at a stale port — the actually-running r-co-db_test-1 container maps 5432 to host port 5434, not 5433 as declared in docker-compose.yml (environment drift, out of scope for this gate). Running the compiled test binary directly (bypassing the zig build wrapper's misleading progress-tree renderer) with the corrected port produced 'All 4 tests passed.' at real exit code 0, and a post-run DB check confirmed zero leaked tenant schemas/rows, empirically confirming the cleanup-on-all-paths check.

issues.description: BPM_TEST_DB_URL in the current shell environment (postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/...) does not match the actual host port (5434) of the running r-co-db_test-1 container per `docker port`; docker-compose.yml declares 5433:5432 but the live container was evidently started with a different mapping. This caused AuthenticationFailed against port 5433 (nothing was listening as bpm/bpm there) when run with the ambient env var. Not a defect in the ISS-502 test file or design — noted for TEST-RUNNER/infrastructure to reconcile the env var or restart the container to match docker-compose.yml before Step 4.
